cases.review: Does the first phase exercise the existing production boundary and preserve existing behavior?
The owner requires save and validation errors. Does any stage silently drop validation?
Does enrichment introduce an unapproved permission policy or integration?
Can Dev execute every delivery row in an actual numbered phase?
Could the proposed verification distinguish a correct save from a no-op handler?
Does Planner reconcile the changed decision and require a current Sheldon review before rebinding?
Are diagnostics useful without retroactively blocking historical plans?
Is a promised behavior implemented in a phase rather than merely mentioned in an appendix?
